ov: A tree-dwelling viverrid of South and Southeast Asia, also called the bearcat, with long, thick, mostly dark hair. It climbs with the help of a long, bushy prehensile tail, and is mainly active at night.
df: Mostly fruit, especially figs, plus small mammals, birds, insects and other small animals.
fx: Its urine contains 2-AP, the same compound made when popcorn pops.
It spreads the seeds of strangler figs, which makes it a keystone species.
notes: The animals.js fact is confirmed: it smells of hot buttered popcorn because of 2-AP in the urine it scent-marks with.
